meta.name: canvas-design
meta.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据描述生成原创视觉设计图片和PDF文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成原创海报、艺术图或静态视觉设计。
copy.tagline_en: Create original visual art and PDF documents from descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate original posters, artwork, or static visual designs.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先写一份设计哲学（.md 文件），再把它视觉化成单页 PDF 或 PNG 作品，画面以视觉设计为主、文字极少，最后交付哲学文件和可下载成品。
howto.when: 当你要求做海报、艺术作品、设计等静态平面作品时触发。默认产出一页，要求多页时会扩展成同一哲学下的其他页面。

say.text: 帮我做一张关于深海探测的海报
say.note: 先生成设计哲学 .md，再输出 PDF 或 PNG

say.text: 把这个主题做成 3 页的 PDF
say.note: 沿用同一设计哲学扩展多页

say.text: 不要加新元素，把现有画面再打磨一遍
say.note: 会回到代码做第二次修整

howto.what_en: Claude first writes a design philosophy as a .md file, then expresses it visually as one-page .pdf or .png art with minimal text. You get the .md file plus a downloadable PDF or PNG.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for a poster, a piece of art, a design, or another static piece. It outputs one page by default, and adds more pages when you ask.

say_en.text: Make me a poster about deep-sea exploration
say_en.note: Writes the philosophy .md, then outputs a PDF or PNG

say_en.text: Turn this theme into a 3-page PDF
say_en.note: Extends the same philosophy across more pages

say_en.text: Don't add new elements, just refine the current piece
say_en.note: Goes back to the code for a second pass
